stage_entry.text: 准备正中胸骨切开，进入心脏重建阶段。
stage_entry.text_en: Prepare for median sternotomy and entry into the cardiac reconstruction.

stage_entry.text: 胸骨切开和止血器械已经准备完毕。
stage_entry.text_en: The instruments for sternotomy and haemostasis are ready.

stage_entry.text: 核对体外循环准备状态，随后建立右心房暴露。
stage_entry.text_en: Confirm bypass readiness, then establish right atrial exposure.

stage_entry.text: 循环及氧合指标持续监测，准备配合体外循环转换。
stage_entry.text_en: Circulatory and oxygenation parameters are under continuous monitoring. We are ready for bypass transition.

stage_entry.text: 右心房的暴露范围需要满足瓣叶评估。
stage_entry.text_en: The right atrial exposure must be sufficient for leaflet assessment.

stage_entry.text: 先判断三尖瓣前叶的活动范围，再逐步游离组织。
stage_entry.text_en: Assess the mobility of the anterior tricuspid leaflet before progressively mobilizing the tissue.

stage_entry.text: 瓣叶可用组织需要保留，分离不要过深。
stage_entry.text_en: Preserve usable leaflet tissue and avoid overly deep dissection.

stage_entry.text: 细致瓣叶游离所需的器械已经就位。
stage_entry.text_en: The instruments for delicate leaflet mobilization are ready.

precision_failed.text: 前叶的游离层次偏离了计划，需要重新辨认。
precision_failed.text_en: The anterior leaflet mobilization has strayed from the intended plane. Reidentify it.

precision_failed.text: 这段瓣叶组织的活动度还没达到要求，先调整。
precision_failed.text_en: The leaflet tissue does not yet have the required mobility. Adjust it first.

stage_entry.text: 处理后叶和隔叶，特别注意隔叶附近的重要结构。
stage_entry.text_en: Work on the posterior and septal leaflets, paying particular attention to critical nearby structures.

stage_entry.text: 后叶组织的活动度还需要逐段确认。
stage_entry.text_en: Posterior leaflet mobility still needs to be assessed segment by segment.

stage_entry.text: 保持隔侧结构的辨认清楚，再继续游离。
stage_entry.text_en: Keep the septal anatomy clearly identified before continuing mobilization.

precision_failed.text: 隔叶附近的组织界面仍不清楚，暂缓推进。
precision_failed.text_en: The tissue plane near the septal leaflet remains unclear. Pause before proceeding.

precision_failed.text: 后叶游离范围不足，需要重新检查。
precision_failed.text_en: Posterior leaflet mobilization remains insufficient. Reassess the area.

stage_entry.text: 复核可用瓣叶面积，确定 Cone 的重建方向。
stage_entry.text_en: Reassess the available leaflet area and determine the direction of cone reconstruction.

stage_entry.text: 瓣环和游离瓣叶的对应关系需要再核对。
stage_entry.text_en: Recheck the relationship between the annulus and the mobilized leaflets.

stage_entry.text: 开始将游离瓣叶组织旋转组合，逐步形成漏斗样瓣叶结构。
stage_entry.text_en: Begin rotating and combining the mobilized leaflet tissue to form the cone.

stage_entry.text: 保持瓣叶边缘方向一致，避免旋转时折叠。
stage_entry.text_en: Keep the leaflet edges aligned and avoid folding during rotation.

stage_entry.text: Cone 重建用细缝线已备妥。
stage_entry.text_en: Fine sutures for cone reconstruction are ready.

precision_failed.text: Cone 的组织方向尚未对齐，不能进入固定。
precision_failed.text_en: The cone tissue is not aligned yet. We cannot proceed to fixation.

precision_failed.text: 瓣叶边缘出现不理想的折叠，需要重新整理。
precision_failed.text_en: The leaflet edge has folded undesirably. It needs to be repositioned.

stage_entry.text: 接下来处理心房化右室，并调整瓣环的几何关系。
stage_entry.text_en: Next, address the atrialized right ventricle and adjust annular geometry.

stage_entry.text: 折叠范围要和最终瓣叶活动空间相协调。
stage_entry.text_en: Coordinate the plication extent with the final space needed for leaflet movement.

stage_entry.text: 先核对右室壁与瓣环的相对位置。
stage_entry.text_en: Recheck the relationship between the right ventricular wall and the annulus.

precision_failed.text: 右室折叠与瓣环调整的关系还不理想，需要修正。
precision_failed.text_en: The relationship between ventricular plication and annular adjustment is unsatisfactory. Correct it.

precision_failed.text: 先重新检查这一处张力，再继续下一步。
precision_failed.text_en: Reassess the tension at this site before moving to the next step.

stage_entry.text: 准备把形成的 Cone 重新附着到解剖瓣环。
stage_entry.text_en: Prepare to reattach the reconstructed cone at the anatomical annulus.

stage_entry.text: 沿瓣环保持均匀对位，避免局部牵拉。
stage_entry.text_en: Maintain even alignment along the annulus and avoid localized traction.

stage_entry.text: 瓣环附着所需的缝线已经递上。
stage_entry.text_en: The sutures for annular attachment are ready.

precision_failed.text: Cone 与瓣环的附着对位还不符合要求。
precision_failed.text_en: Alignment between the cone and annulus does not yet meet the intended standard.

precision_failed.text: 局部瓣叶张力不均，需要修正固定位置。
precision_failed.text_en: Local leaflet tension is uneven. Revise the attachment position.

stage_entry.text: 进行瓣叶对合测试，寻找仍需修正的边缘。
stage_entry.text_en: Test leaflet coaptation and identify any edges that still need adjustment.

stage_entry.text: 检查接合线的连续性，特别是隔侧区域。
stage_entry.text_en: Review the continuity of the coaptation line, especially near the septal side.

stage_entry.text: 保留足够的瓣叶活动度，不能只追求静态贴合。
stage_entry.text_en: Preserve adequate leaflet mobility; static apposition alone is not enough.

precision_failed.text: 瓣叶对合仍存在间隙，需要针对性调整。
precision_failed.text_en: A gap remains in leaflet coaptation. Targeted adjustment is needed.

precision_failed.text: 这处对合线不连续，先修正再复核。
precision_failed.text_en: The coaptation line is discontinuous here. Correct it before retesting.

stage_entry.text: 对合复核完成后整理右心房，再进入关闭阶段。
stage_entry.text_en: Once the coaptation review is complete, prepare the right atrium for closure.

stage_entry.text: 右心房关闭所需的缝线已就位。
stage_entry.text_en: The sutures for right atrial closure are ready.

stage_entry.text: 准备配合脱离体外循环，持续观察循环反应。
stage_entry.text_en: We are ready to assist with weaning from bypass and to monitor the circulatory response.

stage_entry.text: 复核三尖瓣功能与右心室表现，再决定后续步骤。
stage_entry.text_en: Review tricuspid valve function and right ventricular performance before proceeding.

stage_entry.text: 重点关注瓣叶对合状态和残余反流。
stage_entry.text_en: Focus on leaflet coaptation and any residual regurgitation.

stage_entry.text: 开始最终清点，器械和纱布记录正在复核。
stage_entry.text_en: Final counts are under way. Instrument and swab records are being checked.

stage_entry.text: 检查术野和胸腔引流准备情况。
stage_entry.text_en: Review the operative field and chest drainage preparation.

stage_entry.text: 确认可以完成胸骨关闭，结束重建流程。
stage_entry.text_en: Confirm readiness for sternal closure and completion of the reconstruction.

stage_entry.text: 最终器械清点与手术记录已核对。
stage_entry.text_en: The final instrument count and operative record have been checked.
